user.title: Weather Effects

data_description.dashboards: Select dashboards or enter their URL path, e.g. lovelace or dashboard-home. No full URL, leading slash or view path. Effects never appear in settings.
data_description.weather_entity: Required only in automatic mode. Suggested entity: weather.forecast_work_work.
data_description.enable_entity: Optional: select input_boolean.christmasmode or another switch. Effects run only while it is on. Clear this field to stop using it.
data_description.forecast_offset: 0 = current conditions; +1 to +72 = nearest hourly forecast. Outside forecast coverage or on errors, fall back to current conditions (see diagnostic sensor).
data_description.effect: Used in manual mode only. Automatic mode chooses effects from the weather entity.
data_description.cloud_top: Default cloud-center upper limit (0 = top of screen). Shared Clouds overrides are on the Clouds tab. Must not exceed the lower limit; sprites may extend beyond the center band.
data_description.cloud_bottom: Default cloud-center lower limit (100 = bottom of screen). Raise this first to allow clouds lower down. Must be at least the upper limit.
data_description.cloud_spread: Default spacing: 0 = random placement, 100 = stronger distribution and coherent drift. Very large/dense clouds can still overlap. Fog is separate.
data_description.respect_reduced_motion: Pause effects if your device requests reduced motion. Lightning is ALWAYS disabled by reduced motion, even if this switch is off.
data_description.adaptive_weather: Automatic mode only: adapt to available temperature, cloud coverage, rainfall and wind. Missing values keep the saved preset; rainfall may be an hourly forecast estimate.
data_description.heat_threshold: Above this Celsius temperature, sunny effects gain a warmer glow and subtle heat haze.
data_description.lightning_enabled: Warning: flashing light can affect photosensitive users. Off by default. Enable explicitly for storm effects; never active with reduced motion.
data_description.lightning_interval: One lightning event at most per interval across profiles. Minimum 5 seconds, extended if needed to finish the animation plus a pause; no repeated strobe bursts.
data_description.lightning_brightness: Maximum screen-wash alpha, capped at 0.25. Only used if screen flash is enabled. The bolt itself has separate glow/thickness.
data_description.lightning_bolt_enabled: Independent visible bolt switch; the master must also be enabled. Turning off screen flash still allows slow bolt formation.
data_description.lightning_flash_enabled: Photosensitivity warning: adds one brief screen-light pulse at the completed strike, not during leader formation. Master consent is still required.
data_description.lightning_formation_time: 0.1–3 seconds for the main leader to form. Lower is faster; side branches appear only after the leader reaches them.
data_description.lightning_duration: 0.3–2 seconds for the completed bolt to fade. Screen flash stays brief and does not follow this fade duration.
data_description.lightning_branches: 0–8 bounded side branches. Zero leaves only the main bolt.
data_description.lightning_thickness: Width of the bright bolt core in CSS pixels, 0.5–4.
data_description.lightning_glow: Soft outer glow, 0–1; it does not change screen-flash brightness.
data_description.lightning_length: Main bolt reach as a fraction of screen height: 0.2–0.9, default 0.6.
data_description.speed: Legacy/default fallback for components without saved settings. Each card tab edits its shared component in every weather combination.
data_description.size: Legacy/default fallback for components without saved settings. Each card tab edits its shared component in every weather combination.
data_description.density: Legacy/default fallback for components without saved settings. Each card tab edits its shared component in every weather combination.
data_description.opacity: Legacy/default fallback for components without saved settings. Each card tab edits its shared component in every weather combination.
data_description.wind: Legacy/default fallback for components without saved settings. Each card tab edits its shared component in every weather combination.

user.description: Choose where and how weather effects appear. All options can be changed later.

error.invalid_dashboard: Enter a dashboard URL path, not a full URL, view path or settings panel.
error.weather_required: Select a weather entity for automatic mode.
error.entity_missing: This entity does not exist or has the wrong domain.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite number within the allowed range and step.
error.invalid_cloud_bounds: The top cloud-center limit must not exceed the bottom limit.
